## Feature Overview

A clear and concise description of what feature or mechanic you'd like to see added.

---

## Motivation

Why should this feature be added to True Physics? What problem or gap does it solve?

---

## Proposed Implementation Details (Optional)

If you have thoughts on how this could work mechanics-wise or configuration options that should accompany it, list them here.

---

## Performance Considerations

Does this feature affect heavy tick logic, world generation, or rendering? If so, how do you envision keeping performance optimal?
